dialog.english: ��������*cough, cough*
Kari!
Looks like her cold's returned...
Kari... Are you okay?

Why didn't you tell us? You've
been sick for a while, haven't
you?
dialog.translation:
Por qué no dijiste nada?
Llevas tiempo enferma, no?

dialog.english:
I know, but... if we don't
hurry... the Earth will...
dialog.translation:
Ya lo sé, pero si no nos
damos prisa... la Tierra...

dialog.english: Kari...

I *knew* we shouldn't have brought
her with us!
dialog.translation:
Lo sabía! No deberíamos
haberla traído!

dialog.english:
Huh? But unless Kari is here, we
won't be able to save the Digimon
world, or the Earth!
dialog.translation:
Eh? Pero si Kari no está aquí,
no podremos salvar ni el
Digimundo ni la Tierra!

dialog.english:
But she's the kind of person who
never says anything and keeps it
to herself...
dialog.translation:
Pero ella es de las que nunca
dice nada y se lo guarda
todo...

dialog.english: Tai...
There's a town here!

Thank goodness there happened to
be a town nearby.
dialog.translation:
Menos mal que había un
pueblo cerca.

dialog.english:
Isn't it weird, though? There
aren't any Digimon in this town at
all.
dialog.translation:
No os parece raro? No hay
ni un solo Digimon en este
pueblo.

dialog.english:
We're just lucky to be able to
find a bed for Kari.
dialog.translation:
Menos mal que hemos
encontrado una cama para Kari.

dialog.english: Kari... are you okay?

I'll go out and find some medicine
for Kari. Sorry, but... can you
take care of her?
dialog.translation:
Voy a buscar medicinas para
Kari. Lo siento, pero...
puedes cuidarla?

dialog.english: Of course. Be careful, Tai.
I'll go with you!
No, I need you to stay here.

We don't know when the Dark
Masters might attack us again.
dialog.translation:
No sabemos cuándo volverán a
atacar los Amos Oscuros.

dialog.english:
Okay! I'll protect everyone here,
then!
dialog.translation:
Vale! Entonces protegeré a
todos aquí!

dialog.english: Just leave it to us!
Good man!

Tai, there's a hospital! I'm
sure we'll be able to find some
medicine there!
dialog.translation:
Tai, hay un hospital! Seguro
que allí encontramos
medicinas!

dialog.english: Okay, let's hurry!
Agumon! Did you find anything...

Bandages... adhesive plaster...
nope, I can't find anything...
dialog.translation:
Vendas... tiritas...
nada, no encuentro nada...

dialog.english: Tai, I've found medicine!
Really?

Ugh, there's way too many
different kinds. Which one's cold
medicine?
dialog.translation:
Uf, hay demasiados tipos
distintos. Cuál es la del
resfriado?

dialog.english:
If only Joe were here... His
father is a doctor, isn't he?
dialog.translation:
Ojalá estuviera Joe aquí...
Su padre es médico, no?

dialog.english:
It wouldn't be Joe if he were
around whenever you needed him...
dialog.translation:
No sería Joe si apareciera
justo cuando se le
necesita...

dialog.english:
I know! We can use the Internet to
look up which one is cold
medicine!
dialog.translation:
Ya sé! Podemos buscar en
Internet cuál es la del
resfriado!

dialog.english: That's it! Go for it!
All right!

Lord Mugendramon, our connection
has been accessed from within the
hospital.
dialog.translation:
Señor Mugendramon, han
accedido a nuestra red desde
dentro del hospital.

dialog.english:
Hmph... set the hospital as the
target, and prepare to attack!
dialog.translation:
Hmph... marcad el hospital
como objetivo, atacad!

dialog.english: Roger! Metal Empire forces! March!
Metal Empire forces! March!
Here it is!
No doubt about it!
Great. Let's go back.
Aaaaaah!
What?!

At this rate, the building will
collapse! Tai, we need to get
out!
dialog.translation:
Como sigamos así, el edificio
se derrumbará! Tai, tenemos
que salir!

dialog.english: Right!
Aaaaagh! The heck are those?
Ugh, now isn't the time for this!
dialog.translation:
Uf, no es momento para
esto!

dialog.english: Get out of the way!
Now the town's full of Digimon!
dialog.translation:
Hay Digimon por todo el
pueblo!

dialog.english: You think they know we're here?

It's possible that they saw us
while we were entering the
hospital.
dialog.translation:
Es posible que nos vieran
mientras entrábamos en el
hospital.

dialog.english:
Gh! Right when we'd found the
medicine...

Why don't we hide for a bit and
wait it out?
dialog.translation:
Por qué no esperamos
escondidos un rato?

dialog.english:
Okay. Let's find a place to hide,
then.

Tai, let's rest here for a
bit...
This a good place?

A church? Well... it'll have to do
for now.
dialog.translation:
Una iglesia? Bueno, tendrá
que valer.

dialog.english: That's it!
What's up, Izzy?
I was careless...

Our enemies located our position 
from the signal I transmitted when 
I accessed their network...
dialog.translation:
Nuestros enemigos localizaron
nuestra posición por la señal
que emití al acceder a su red..

dialog.english:
What a great time to be careless!
Now we're here, while Kari is...
dialog.translation:
Vaya momento para
descuidarse! Ahora estamos
aquí, mientras Kari...

dialog.english: Hey there, Tai...

What's wrong, Tai? You're not
acting like yourself. Is it
because of Kari?
dialog.translation:
Qué te pasa, Tai? No pareces
tú mismo. Es por Kari?

dialog.english: Ah... I... I'm sorry...

Did something in particular
happen, Tai?
dialog.translation:
Ha pasado algo en especial,
Tai?

dialog.english:
Kari... almost died, once,
because of me.
dialog.translation:
Kari... casi murió una vez
por mi culpa.

dialog.english:
I was in second grade, and she was
in kindergarten. She had a cold,
so she couldn't go to school.
dialog.translation:
Yo estaba en segundo curso y
ella en preescolar. Tenía un
resfriado y no podía ir al cole

dialog.english:
She looked like she was doing
better, so I took her outside to
play.
dialog.translation:
Parecía que estaba mejor, así
que la saqué a jugar fuera.

dialog.english:
But instead, she was on the verge
of death for 3 days 'til she was
discharged from the hospital.
dialog.translation:
Pero en vez de eso, estuvo al
borde de la muerte 3 días
hasta que le dieron el alta.

dialog.english: And on that day, she said...

"Tai... I'm sorry I couldn't
kick the ball very well."
dialog.translation:
"Tai... siento no haber sabido
chutar bien el balón."

dialog.english: Tai...

That's the kind of person she is!
She always puts others before
herself!
dialog.translation:
Así es ella! Siempre antepone
a los demás antes que a ella
misma!

dialog.english:
And if something's bothering her,
she won't say a thing until the 
end, no matter how much it hurts!
dialog.translation:
Y si algo le preocupa, no dice
ni una palabra hasta el final,
por mucho que le duela!

dialog.english:
And that's why she didn't tell us
about her illness until it was too
late...
dialog.translation:
Por eso no nos contó lo de su
enfermedad hasta que fue
demasiado tarde...

dialog.english:
Yeah... and I'm supposed to be
keeping a close eye on her, and
yet...
dialog.translation:
Sí... y se supone que debo
cuidar de ella de cerca, y
aun así...

dialog.english:
Tai, you shouldn't blame
yourself.

That's right! So let's get the
medicine to her, as quickly as we
can!
dialog.translation:
Eso es! Así que llevémosle
la medicina cuanto antes!

dialog.english:
Yeah... but how? We're completely
surrounded.
dialog.translation:
Sí... pero cómo? Estamos
totalmente rodeados.

dialog.english:
We won't be able to attack them
head-on, but we can use their own
tactics against them.
dialog.translation:
No podremos atacarlos de
frente, pero podemos usar sus
propias tácticas contra ellos.

dialog.english: Whaddya mean by that, Izzy?

We'll use a program that masks our
access point.
dialog.translation:
Un programa ocultará
nuestro punto de acceso.

dialog.english:
With this, we will be able to pull
the wool over their eyes.
dialog.translation:
Así podremos engañarlos y
tomarles el pelo.

dialog.english:
We've caught their point of
address! They're...
dialog.translation:
Hemos localizado su punto
de acceso! Están...

dialog.english:
Get to it! Tell me where they are,
now!

...I can't read this! The
reactions are coming from all over
the map!
dialog.translation:
No puedo leer esto! Las
reacciones vienen de todo
el mapa!

dialog.english:
There's the house! We're here,
Kari!
dialog.translation:
Ahí está la casa! Ya
llegamos, Kari!

dialog.english: Kari!
Aaaaaaaah!
No...
N-No way... Kari...
Was that a missile?!
Huh?!
Angemon!
Angemon!
Tai! Are you okay?
T.K!
Kari!
So you were safe after all!

See? I protected everyone like I
said I would, Tai!
dialog.translation:
Ves? Protegí a todos como
dije que haría, Tai!

dialog.english: Great job, T.K!
It's Mugendramon!
Guys, run for it!

This is where you will meet your
end, Chosen Children! Infinity
Cannon!
dialog.translation:
Aquí es donde encontraréis
vuestro fin, Niños Elegidos!
Disparo Infinito!

dialog.english: Gyaaaaah!
Aaaaaaaah!
Tai!
Kariiiiiiii!

Tai, let's look for somewhere
we can find medicine.
dialog.translation:
Tai, busquemos algún sitio
donde encontrar medicinas.

dialog.english: Okay!

It's a church... I don't think
we'll find any medicine here.
dialog.translation:
Es una iglesia... no creo que
encontremos medicinas aquí.

dialog.english: Let's look elsewhere!

It's dangerous to go back to the
hospital! We need to find a place
to hide!
dialog.translation:
Es peligroso volver al
hospital! Necesitamos un
sitio donde escondernos!

dialog.english:
Ugh! Right when we'd gotten the
medicine...

The enemy is confused! Now's our
chance!

We need to hurry over to the
house!
dialog.translation:
Hay que llegar rápido a
la casa!

dialog.english:
An ambush... they're trying to
block our escape routes!
dialog.translation:
Una emboscada... intentan
bloquear nuestra huida!

dialog.english:
We won't be able to get to the
house at this rate.
dialog.translation:
Así no llegaremos nunca a
la casa.

dialog.english:
Tai, we need to find a place to
hide for now!
dialog.translation:
Tai, busquemos un sitio
donde escondernos!
